import csv

with open("synonyms.txt", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = [r for r in csv.reader(f) if r]

print([(r[0], r[2]) for r in rows
       if r[8] == "人工知能"])

word = "人工知能"
ids = {r[0] for r in rows
       if r[8] == word and r[2] in ("", "0")}
candidates = [r[8] for r in rows
              if r[0] in ids and r[2] != "2"
              and r[8] != word]
print(list(dict.fromkeys(candidates)))
